title: MIS roster import: Wonde + GroupCall
description: Auto-import pupils, classes, year groups, and SEND flags from the school's MIS via Wonde or GroupCall. Removes the day-1 'register every pupil' friction completely. After this PR a SENCO connects Wonde once, gets every EHCP-flagged pupil pre-populated, and never re-types a UPN.
rationale: User's improvement #7 part 2. The current Children page requires manual entry which collapses adoption with rosters > 30. Wonde already aggregates SIMS / Bromcom / Arbor / iSAMS / Engage / Pass — connecting Wonde once gives Adaptly access to ~95% of UK schools' MIS data. GroupCall covers the Capita SIMS estate that doesn't go through Wonde.
constraints: MIS data is highly sensitive (UPN, DOB, EHCP status). Reads only — never write back.
Sync runs server-side on a schedule; no MIS data is exposed to the browser beyond what's already in Children/Pupils.

Pupil records imported from MIS are flagged read-only for fields that come from the MIS (name, UPN, DOB, year group); the teacher can still edit Adaptly-added fields (SEND need overrides, EHCP outcomes, IEP targets).
Wonde token sits in env. Per-school API key is stored encrypted in `schools.misConnection`.
steps: Add `server/integrations/mis/` with:
- wonde.ts — REST client. Endpoints used: GET /v1.0/schools/:id/students, GET /v1.0/schools/:id/classes (deep), GET /v1.0/schools/:id/employees. Pagination via `next_url`.
- groupCall.ts — Same shape against the Xporter on Demand API.

- mapper.ts — pure function MisStudent → AdaptlyChild. Maps: legalName, knownAs, UPN, DOB, yearGroup, registrationGroup, SEN status (CoP K/E codes), EHCP flag, primary need code, HD primary, secondary needs.
Database:
- Add `schools` table (multi-tenant scaffolding) if not present: id, name, mis_provider, mis_credentials_encrypted, last_sync_at.
- Add `pupils.mis_id` + `pupils.mis_synced_at` + `pupils.mis_locked_fields jsonb` to mark MIS-sourced fields as read-only.
- Drizzle migration.
Server routes (requireAuth + role 'admin' for the school):
- POST /api/integrations/mis/connect → body: { provider: 'wonde'|'groupcall'; apiKey: string }. Validates by hitting the provider's status endpoint; encrypts and stores.
- POST /api/integrations/mis/sync   → enqueues a sync job; returns syncId.
- GET  /api/integrations/mis/sync/:id → status + summary { added, updated, deactivated, errors }.
- GET  /api/integrations/mis/preview → dry-run sync (returns a diff without writing).

Background job: nightly sync via the existing `node-cron` infrastructure (grep for `cron`); manual sync via the route. Soft-delete pupils that disappear from MIS (set `mis_synced_at = null`, do NOT hard-delete).
Client:
- Settings → Integrations → 'MIS roster' card with provider picker, API key input, 'Test connection' button, 'Run sync now' button, last-sync summary.
- Children page: small 'Wonde-synced' badge on imported pupils; mis-locked fields render with a lock icon and a tooltip.
Tests:
- server/tests/integrations/mis/wonde.test.ts — mocks the Wonde HTTP client, verifies pagination, SEND flag mapping, soft-delete behaviour.
- server/tests/integrations/mis/mapper.test.ts — pure mapper unit tests against fixture MIS payloads (Wonde + GroupCall).
Docs: docs/integrations/mis.md — IT admin onboarding steps for both providers.
Feature flag: `MIS_WONDE_ENABLED`, `MIS_GROUPCALL_ENABLED`. Default off.
do_not_touch: LMS push routes from PC1 (separate concern)
Existing manual pupil add/edit flow on Children.tsx — keep working unchanged for non-MIS pupils
acceptance_criteria: A teacher with admin role on a school can connect Wonde, run a sync, and see all MIS pupils appear in Children with correct year group + SEND flags.
Re-running sync is idempotent (no duplicates, updates apply, missing pupils soft-delete).
MIS-locked fields cannot be edited from the UI.
Sync handles ≥ 2,000 pupils without crashing the request (background job).
All Wonde + GroupCall mapper unit tests pass.
pnpm run check + pnpm run build + pnpm test --run pass.
verification: Manual: connect Wonde sandbox, run sync, verify ≥ 100 sample pupils import correctly with SEND flags.

size_estimate.notes: above the 600 budget — split into PC2a (Wonde + mapper) + PC2b (GroupCall + sync UI) if a fresh chat needs to

context_budget_for_fresh_chat: MEDIUM. Read Wonde API docs first call; reuse PC1's OAuth scaffold.
